conventions.placeholders: A string wrapped in angle brackets (e.g. "<generatedAt>") stands for a value computed at refresh time, not a literal to match byte-for-byte.

demo-alpha.canvas-export/api/course.json note: redactValue() replaces any 'token=...'-shaped substring inside every captured field, including rich text like syllabus_body, before the file is written.
demo-alpha.canvas-export/api/modules.json note: Both pages concatenated into one array; the page boundary and the Link header are not preserved in this file (they live in request-manifest.json instead).
demo-alpha.canvas-export/api/assignments.json note: minimizeAssignmentSubmission() has already narrowed 'submission' to workflow_state/submitted_at/graded_at/grade/score/excused/missing/late by this point; no other submission fields (e.g. raw rubric assessment) are ever captured.
demo-alpha.canvas-export/api/files.json note: The stored 'url' has lost its ?verifier=... query string: writeJson()/safeUrl() strips the query before persisting, even though the download itself used the full URL.
demo-alpha.canvas-export/download-manifest.json not: filename is `${canvasFileId}-${nameFromContentDisposition}`; status is one of "downloaded", "reused" (fingerprint match: id+filename+size+updated_at against the prior manifest, plus the local copy existing at the expected size), "missing-download-url", or a bare HTTP status number when the download itself failed.
demo-alpha.canvas-export/request-manifest.json note: Every recorded url is origin+pathname only (safeUrl() strips the query string, so ?include[]=... and ?per_page=100 never appear here); modules has two entries, one per fetched page, both with the query-stripped pathname repeated.
demo-alpha.canvas-export/course-inventory.json: The full per-endpoint capture object plus a capturedAt timestamp: { capturedAt: "<capturedAt>", course: <as above>, tabs: <as above>, pages: <as above>, modules: <as above, concatenated>, assignment_groups: <as above>, assignments: <as above>, discussions: [], announcements: <as above>, files: <as above>, folders: <as above> }.

coursework.md excerpts.note: Written unconditionally on every --apply run (even when applied === 0), via a direct overwrite (no temp file, no rename) — the one non-atomic write in this whole chain.

canvas-conversations.json.path-note: The wrapper's own --output argument to sync-canvas-conversations.mjs is canvas-inbox.json (confirmed from the private wrapper's source), but dashboard-store.ts, its Playwright seed script, and this repo's own entrypoint test all read/write canvas-conversations.json. This fixture uses canvas-conversations.json because that is what the dashboard actually consults; docs/REFRESH-CONTRACT.md marks the true on-disk filename `unknown` pending an owner-side check of the live legacy root.

coursework-refresh-history.json event.note: "points" is absent from the changed-fields list because it did not change (20 both before and after) — Object.is() only reports fields that actually differ. The REMOVE of demo-alpha-forecast-1 never appears here at all: captureCanvasSnapshot() only tracks items where source === "canvas" and canvasId is set, so a forecast item is invisible to this diff in both the before and after snapshot regardless of what the reconciliation script did to it.
